provenance.author: we* + @mizopl
provenance.method: 0-pivot tau-Galois descent over Q(omega_3, sqrt(3)) / Q(omega_3) in exact Z[omega_3] arithmetic

llm.role: we* multi-agent algebraic quotient and exact certificate synthesis

notes: Upgrades the m=3 bound of arXiv:2605.28586 from reproduced to verified (exact: true). Unnormalised |H3> = (1 + sqrt(3))|0> + |1> + |2> lies in Z[sqrt(3)]^3, while every qutrit stabilizer state has coordinates in Z[omega_3] subset Q(sqrt(-3)). Since [Q(omega_3, sqrt(3)) : Q(omega_3)] = 2, the Galois automorphism tau(sqrt(3)) = -sqrt(3), tau(omega_3) = omega_3 fixes every qutrit stabilizer state and forces any rank-3 decomposition of |H3>^3 to contain the 2D subspace V_3(H3) = span(v_0, v_1) subset Z^27. Thus all 3 stabilizer states would project to a single ray modulo V_3(H3). Across all 30,240 three-qutrit stabilizer states in exact Z[omega_3] arithmetic, no state lies in V_3(H3) and the maximum ray bucket size modulo V_3(H3) is 1 (0 pivots needed, 0.11 s). Positive control: at m=2, 3 buckets of size >= 3 are found.
